row: We are a continuing education provider for licensed professionals who have already completed rudimentary health care training in their respective field. Massage and bodywork is generally a licensed health care practice, and should not be applied or provided without a license or completing rudimentary health care training.  Health risks, precautions, contraindications and more must be considered prior to practicing hands-on massage, bodywork and/or medical care at all times.
